case_number: 2025 INSC 320; PETITION FOR SPECIAL LEAVE TO APPEAL (CRL.) NO. 3247 OF 2025
summary: Anticipatory bail denial upheld; Section 7 Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 violation; demand for illegal gratification as Audit Inspector during audit; middleman Prithvi Singh collected bribe; audio recording evidence; mere demand constitutes offence; no requirement of actual bribe exchange; reliance on Calcutta High Court (1905) and Bombay High Court (1955) precedents; bail petition dismissed.
final_judgment: Exemption Applications allowed; anticipatory bail denied; petition dismissed.
